title: The Side Hustle
text: Everyone in town has a side hustle. Your mum sells candles that smell of “Tuesday”. Time you had one too.

ok.text: Your lemon drizzle becomes a town legend. People queue in the rain. Your mum is jealous.

effects.remember: Started a cake business from your window.

fail.text: The cakes are fine. The kitchen fire is less fine.

ok.text: You sell {crush}'s bread and your nonsense. It works. You both pretend it's only business.

cast.did: said yes and brought an apron

fail.text: {crush} says yes, then sells the business idea to {rival} for 50 €.

choices.label: Fix cars in your mum's driveway at weekends

ok.text: By spring the whole street brings their cars to you. Your mum charges them for parking.

effects.remember: Ran a weekend garage in your mum's driveway.

choices.label: Launch an app that tells you when the bakery has fresh bread

ok.text: 4,000 downloads in a week. The bakery hates it. You're in business.

effects.remember: Launched the town's most useful app.

ok.text: They sell like crazy. They also melt in the sun, which is a problem for sunglasses.

reveal.text: A customer's sunglasses melt on live TV at the beach. The reporter finds your website. And your address.

effects.remember: Sold fake sunglasses. They melted later.

title: The Bank Loan
text: You need money for your business idea. The bank manager is {rival}'s uncle. He has a photo of {rival} on his desk. Several.

ok.text: The charts go up and to the right. So does his eyebrow. You get the loan.

effects.remember: Got a business loan from {rival}'s uncle.

fail.text: He says your charts are “a bit optimistic” and shows you {rival}'s charts. They're better.

ok.text: {rival} calls {rival.his} uncle: “Give it to them. I want to watch.” You get the loan.

effects.remember: {rival} vouched for you at the bank.

cast.did: vouched for you, out of curiosity

fail.text: {rival} calls {rival.his} uncle too. You hear the laughter through the wall.

cast.did: laughed you out of the bank

choices.label: Read the contract and fix three illegal clauses

ok.text: The uncle is so impressed he gives you a better rate and asks for your number. For his own divorce.

effects.remember: Fixed the bank's own contract and got a cheaper loan.

choices.label: Skip the bank and use the money under your mattress

ok.text: You count it. It's 31 €. You buy one very good chair. It's a start.

effects.remember: Funded your business from under the mattress. Bought a chair.

text.text: Your side hustle is doing well enough that a man offers you his old food truck. It has a giant fibreglass sausage on the roof. The sausage is negotiable.
A man offers you his old food truck. It has a giant fibreglass sausage on the roof. The sausage is negotiable.

ok.text: The sausage becomes a landmark. People give directions by it. Business booms.

effects.remember: Bought a food truck with a giant sausage on the roof.

fail.text: The engine dies on the first day, in the middle of the roundabout. The sausage stays there for a week.

effects.remember: Bought a food truck. It died on the roundabout.

ok.text: You get it for half. He throws in the sausage and a lifetime supply of mustard.

effects.remember: Haggled a food truck down to half price.

fail.text: You haggle so aggressively that he sells it to {rival} instead, out of spite.

hothead.text: You call his sausage “an insult to sausages”. He calls the police. You call his mum. Nobody sells anything.

ok.text: He sells it to {rival}. You hear the sausage horn every morning at 7.
